about: Runtime files and exports that no test imported when the coverage gaps test landed (18 November 2026), so only a test that spawns them proves them. The test fails on any gap fallow reports that is not listed here, and on any listed gap that fallow no longer reports: remove an entry in the change that adds a test importing it.

hits.reason: The pin move command's main predates MAG-127, and only the pin move command tests that spawn it prove it. Fallow reports it once .fallowrc.json lists scripts/pin-verification.ts and scripts/kernel-trial-command.ts as entries, because both import scripts/pin-move.ts.

Bootstrap's main predates MAG-127, and only the Bootstrap tests that spawn it prove it. Fallow reports it once .fallowrc.json lists scripts/kernel-trial-command.ts as an entry, which reaches src/bootstrap.ts through the kernel trial.
